skill.summary: Diagnose WHY a deal is accumulating objections by tracing each one back to its root-cause seller behavior. Use this skill when a customer keeps pushing back,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.

- Diagnoses the root cause of sales objections by analyzing call notes and transcripts and mapping each objection to specific seller behaviors using SPIN and FAB methodologies.
- Produces an objection prevention plan outlining which seller behaviors to remove and which SPIN questions to use in future calls.
- Refuses to generate objection-handling scripts, focusing instead on upstream behavioral changes to prevent recurrence.
- Designed for B2B account executives, enterprise sales reps, managers, and solution consultants dealing with excessive customer objections.
